AlertChannelCapabilityAuthority.description: Durable channel claim governing retries after an unknown delivery.
AlertChannelCapabilityAuthority.title: AlertChannelCapabilityAuthority

ArtifactRef.description: A kind-discriminated reference with syntax fixed by the artifact kind.
ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef

BacklogCompletionReceipt.description:
Immutable receipt for an atomic retry attempt and Case/audit transition.

Replaying the exact outcome under the exact lease must return this same
``receipt_id``.  A caller-visible ``created`` flag belongs to the repository
return wrapper and is intentionally excluded from the durable identity.
BacklogCompletionReceipt.title: BacklogCompletionReceipt

BacklogItem.description: One immutable retry identity with explicit mutable lease progress.
BacklogItem.title: BacklogItem

BacklogLeaseIdentity.description: Non-secret CAS identity for one exact leased backlog generation.
BacklogLeaseIdentity.title: BacklogLeaseIdentity

BacklogParseFailureEvidence.description: Typed references for one persisted strict-parser failure.
BacklogParseFailureEvidence.title: BacklogParseFailureEvidence

BacklogRetryContext.description:
Request identity input that changes only after a proven parse failure.

The lease is deliberately absent.  A provider outage, timeout, or unknown
worker crash may result in another lease, but must keep the same model
request identity so durable claim/journal recovery can prevent a duplicate
external call.
BacklogRetryContext.title: BacklogRetryContext

BacklogRetryDisposition.description: Stable public result of one bounded backlog-worker invocation.
BacklogRetryDisposition.title: BacklogRetryDisposition

BacklogRetryFailure.description: One atomic retry failure, including any controlled generation advance.
BacklogRetryFailure.title: BacklogRetryFailure

BacklogRetryReport.description: Public, secret-free report for reclaiming and processing at most one item.
BacklogRetryReport.title: BacklogRetryReport

BacklogRetrySuccess.description: Intent for one M3 business success under an exact lease identity.
BacklogRetrySuccess.title: BacklogRetrySuccess

BacklogStrictParseFailureProof.description:
Two persisted, billable strict failures authorizing one new generation.

IDs are public references only.  The repository remains responsible for
loading both receipts, proving their request/response/generation bindings,
revalidating raw responses, and atomically accounting their usage.
BacklogStrictParseFailureProof.title: BacklogStrictParseFailureProof

M3ProcessCaseOutcome.description: One case result without prompts, raw responses, paths, or secrets.
M3ProcessCaseOutcome.title: M3ProcessCaseOutcome

M3ProcessDisposition.description: Stable distinction between advancement, deferral, observation, and skip.
M3ProcessDisposition.title: M3ProcessDisposition

PilotA2Report.description: Content-derived A2 result without L0 subject or trajectory persistence.
PilotA2Report.title: PilotA2Report

PilotA3Report.description: Secret-free bounded result of real-provider screening over one pilot run.
PilotA3Report.title: PilotA3Report
